evidence: Target features a vertical dust bin situated below the cyclone pack rather than an inline bin.
Shows a central purple pre-motor filter and top red pull-up bin release latch.
Features a purple rear post-motor filter cap with exhaust vents and a top slider switch matching the V8.
The vacuum has a solid blue cylindrical rear motor cap with a round Dyson label sticker.
A DC charging port is located directly on the vertical spine of the handle column.
The cyclone assembly features an exposed center pre-filter knob without a top-pull red ejection handle.
contradictions: The Dyson V8 Absolute features a twist-on vented rear HEPA filter, a top-pull cyclone bin release handle, and a battery-base charge port.
The Dyson V12 Detect Slim and V15 Detect both have straight inline horizontal dust bins and rear LCD screens.

evidence: The target features a prominent circular red power button on top of the gold cyclone body.
The compact inline dust bin and overall body proportions precisely match the V12 Detect Slim design.

The red quick-release catch and clear plastic housing of the attachment are clearly visible.
missing_evidence: Detected objects did not give one consistent resolved identity.
